Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Content: In guest mode, PlanIt stores the schedule locally on the device. After sign-in, schedules synchronize with Firebase and also retain a local copy.
Privacy.section2Content: PlanIt supports email and password, Google Sign-In, and Apple Sign-In on compatible platforms. Authentication data is handled by Firebase Authentication.
Privacy.section3Content: Native builds include Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, and Google Mobile Ads. The full policy describes device data, advertising identifiers, third-party services, retention, and user rights.
Privacy.officialDocument: Open the application's full privacy policy

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Content: PlanIt is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. The service or individual features may be changed or discontinued.
Terms.section2Content: Users are responsible for the legality of information they add to schedules, including teacher contacts, links, and notes. Important data should also be backed up independently.
Terms.section3Content: PlanIt may be available through web and native platform distribution channels. Availability can vary by platform and region.

FAQ.title: What to know about PlanIt.
FAQ.support: Still have questions? Get in touch

price.question: Is PlanIt free? Are there ads or a subscription?
price.answer: PlanIt is free for now. Ads are planned on all platforms, and a subscription may come later — you'll see its price, features and terms before you subscribe.

account.question: Do I need to create an account?
account.answer: No. Choose “Continue as guest” on the sign-in screen; your data stays on that device. You need an account to sync between devices, store files in the cloud and share schedules with a code.

start.question: How do I start if my group already has a schedule?
start.answer: If someone already made it in PlanIt, ask them for a code or link and import a copy. Otherwise create your own: set class times, breaks and the week cycle, then add subjects. Optional fields can wait.

offline.question: Can I use PlanIt without an internet connection?
offline.answer: On Android, yes: your schedule is stored on the device. You need internet to open the web app, sign in, sync and download cloud files. A file opens offline only if a copy is already on the device.

ios.question: Does PlanIt work on iPhone and iPad?
ios.answer: Yes, through the web app in your browser. The native app is on Google Play for Android. The iOS version is in progress, with no release date yet.

reminders.question: Where do reminders and the widget work?
reminders.answer: Only in the Android app, and reminders need notification permission. The web app has no reminders and no widget.

sharing.question: If the author changes the schedule, will my copy update?
sharing.answer: No. You get your own copy. After changes, the author can share a new one. Tasks and cloud attachments are not shared.

files.question: Can I attach PDFs and photos, or import a schedule from a file?
files.answer: Yes, you can attach photos, PDFs, other files and links to classes and tasks. Files stay on the device, or go to the cloud if you sign in. PlanIt doesn't read a schedule from a PDF or photo: enter it yourself or import a copy with a code. You can export a schedule to PDF, Word, Excel, CSV or text.

demo.question: Will changes from the website demos transfer to the app?
demo.answer: No. The demos are examples: “Save” works only inside the demo, and everything resets when you reload the page. Your own schedule lives in the web app.

privacy.question: Where is my data stored, and how can I delete it?
privacy.answer: Guest schedules are stored on the device and are lost if you clear its storage or remove the app. After you sign in, data syncs through Firebase. Technical services, ads and analytics have their own data terms. The privacy policy and account deletion steps are in Documents.
